Correct a data point

Source: R/verification.R
update_data_point.Rd

Changes one data point, re-validates the study against the schema and, by default, marks the data point as verified with a note listing the changes (e.g. "value1: 5.1 -> 5.2"). Use this (or review_values()) rather than editing data.csv by hand, so corrections are documented.

Usage

update_data_point(
  path = ".",
  study_id,
  measurement_id,
  ...,
  verify = TRUE,
  reviewer = NULL,
  note = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Project root.

study_id

Study identifier.

measurement_id

The data point to change.

...

Named new values, e.g. value1 = 5.2, unit = "pg/mL".

verify

Mark the corrected data point as verified? Defaults to TRUE.

reviewer, note

See set_verification(). note is appended to the list of changes.

Value

A character vector describing the changes, invisibly.
